# Propwash Marine Detailing

> Mobile, dockside boat and yacht detailing serving South Florida from Stuart to Fort Lauderdale. We come to your Slip, lift or driveway. Membership maintenance plans, Full Details, paint correction and ceramic coating — every visit documented through an Owner Portal. Salt never sleeps. Neither do we.

## About

Propwash Marine Detailing is a mobile marine detailing company based in Boca Raton, Florida. We detail boats and yachts dockside — at your Slip, on your lift, or in your driveway — across the South Florida coast from Stuart to Fort Lauderdale. Every service is documented with photos delivered to the owner through our Owner Portal. We are BBB Accredited.

We quote every boat individually rather than list flat pricing, because scope depends on the vessel's length, condition and how it is used. Boats 50 feet and over, or with a tower or multiple decks, are quoted individually.

## Services

- Signature Wash — a one-time exterior wash and salt rinse, no membership required
- Full Detail — deep interior and exterior detail: oxidation and rust off the gelcoat, mold off the seats, hatches and compartments cleaned out, brightwork, upholstery and interior spaces
- Wax Protection — machine-applied wax paired with a Full Detail
- Compound + Polish — paint correction for oxidized or dull gelcoat
- Ceramic Coating — long-term protection with preparation matched to the boat; we never coat over oxidation or wax
- Maintenance Plans — recurring membership washes and care on a schedule you set
- Trip Ready prep — the boat prepared before you arrive: wiped down, canvas off, coolers iced, water and drinks stocked, electronics on, lines stowed
- Freshwater Rinse — a focused rinse before or after a run
- Teak care, interior deep cleaning, and hull cleaning coordination

## Membership Plans

We offer three membership tiers. Every plan includes recurring washes on the schedule you set and photos after every visit. Every plan is custom quoted and starts with a separately quoted Full Detail.

- Silver — "Keeps it clean." Recurring washes (weekly, bi-weekly or monthly) with a full exterior wash and salt rinse every visit.
- Gold — "Keeps it maintained." Everything in Silver, plus a complete Full Detail every month, priority scheduling and an assigned detailer. This is our core plan.
- Platinum — "We manage your boat." Invite-only and capped at 15 boats. Everything in Gold, plus two Trip Ready preps a month, on-call washdowns between visits, 24-hour response with spot reporting, and top scheduling priority.

## Owner Portal

Customers and members use the Propwash Owner Portal ("My Slip") to see their boat's condition, service history, visit photos, invoices and payments in one place. Owners can add access notes, choose how covers are left, request interior care, approve work, and report a spot that needs attention.

Just outside that stretch? Ask us.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need to be there for the service?
A: No. Give us access and we handle it. Photos land in your Owner Portal when we are done, so you can see the work wherever you are.

Q: Do you offer boat detailing near me in South Florida?
A: We serve the coast from Stuart to Fort Lauderdale, including Jupiter, Palm Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Deerfield Beach, Lighthouse Point, Pompano Beach and Fort Lauderdale.

Q: Wax or ceramic coating — which does my boat need?
A: It depends on the boat's finish, how it is used, and its maintenance plan. Preparation comes first: we never coat over oxidation or wax.

Q: How often should a boat be washed?
A: It depends on how the boat is stored and used. Silver offers weekly, bi-weekly or monthly washes; Gold and Platinum offer a custom cadence with a Full Detail every month.

Q: Do you detail large boats and yachts?
A: Yes. Boats 50 feet and over, or with a tower or multiple decks, are quoted individually to account for their surface area.

Q: How much does boat detailing cost?
A: Every boat is custom quoted based on length, condition and use. Contact us at (561) 291-8554 or through propwashmarine.com for a free quote.
